subject: Post-discovery: runbook handoff & technical run-through for Skyward
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Thompson <alicia@skyward.ai>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@skyward.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: runbook handoff & technical run-through for Skyward

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the discovery session last week. Based on what we covered, the next best step is a focused technical run-through where our infra/ops engineer walks through a proposed runbook: model selection tradeoffs, network topology for VPC/private deployment, KV cache expectations, and a first-pass cost/latency profile.

Proposed goals for the session (60–75 min):
- Walk through the runbook skeleton and environment assumptions (20 min)
- Discuss inferred SLOs and traffic patterns + fallback strategies (20 min)
- Q&A and open items / action list (20–35 min)

Ben (copied) will lead the runbook walkthrough. Mina will cover security considerations (KMS/HSM, audit logs, retention).

Can you confirm who should attend from your side and share two 1-hr windows (PDT) that work this week or early next? I’ll pick the best option and send a calendar invite with pre-reads.

Attachments: initial runbook draft + requirements matrix (linked below).

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: Skyward_Runbook_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf), Skyward_Requirements.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Alicia Thompson <alicia@skyward.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@skyward.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: runbook handoff & technical run-through for Skyward

Diego —

Thanks — that agenda looks good. Attendees on our side: myself (product), Tom (platform lead), and Maya Patel (SRE). Two windows that work for us (PDT):
- Wed 2027-08-18 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2027-08-19 09:00–10:00

We’re particularly interested in: expected cold-starts for private deployments, how the KV cache behaves under bursty traffic, and what telemetry you’d recommend for cost monitoring.

Also can you send the runbook as a PDF (we prefer annotated copies) and a short pre-read list so our team can prepare?

Cheers,
Alicia
Alicia Thompson
Head of Product, Skyward AI

Alicia —

Great — Wed 8/18 10:00–11:00 PDT works for our side as well. I’ve tentatively blocked that slot and created a Zoom link. Sending the annotated runbook + requirements matrix now (attached).

Pre-reads (10–15 min):
1) Skyward_Runbook_Draft_v1.pdf — high level runbook flow + assumptions (please annotate with specific constraints).
2) Skyward_Requirements.xlsx — short checklist we built from discovery.

Ben / Mina — please prepare:
- Ben: run through the runtime topology (kernels, batching, quantization options) and a rough cost/latency table for 1k qps vs 10k qps.
- Mina: short slide on KMS integration flows and audit-log locations (5–7 min).

I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and links.

Thanks,
Diego
